title: fracdirac: code and data for 'Memory-induced geometric coupling in the fractional dynamics of laser-driven massive Dirac fermions'
description:
Solver library, verification suite, analysis and figure scripts, and the generated data and figures for the article 'Memory-induced geometric coupling in the fractional dynamics of laser-driven massive Dirac fermions' (N. S. Akintsov, A. P. Nevecheria, S. N. Andreev, Q.-H. Qin).

The archive regenerates every number, table and figure of the article: python run_all.py. See README.md for the contents, the model and the numerical parameters.

Code: MIT licence. Data and figures (folders data/ and output/): CC BY 4.0.
